text:
sarah_sales: Hey team — AcmeHealth POC is blocked by procurement. They say order form needs SCCs + DPA redlines before PO will be released. Also asking whether we can accept PO + net30 or require prepay. attaching their order_form_v3.pdf link
eli_legal: thanks for the ping. can you drop the exact redline they sent? sometimes it's just the subprocessor list and liability cap language we can negotiate quickly. @noah_finance FYI on net terms question
noah_finance: Net30 is fine for POC if we have a signed MSA + submitted PO. if they want to delay signature until after PO, we need a billing pledge email from their billing contact. card up front preferred for smaller pilots.
mira_ps: on the technical side they want a dedicated test dataset upload path + SOC2/HIPAA confirmation in the order form. do we have a standard appendix for data handling we can attach?
eli_legal: we do — use the Data Handling Addendum v2.1. I can accept most DPA redlines but can't agree to unlimited liability or removing our audit rights. if they insist on changing sections 4 and 7 we should propose an alternate paragraph.
sarah_sales: copying the specific redline: "Section 7.2 — Customer seeks unlimited liability for data loss and 30-day deletion SLA". they also added a requirement: "Certificates of SCCs for subprocessors attached"
eli_legal: unlimited liability — no. propose a negotiated cap tied to fees for the POC (e.g., cap = 3x POC fees) and keep 30-day deletion as "reasonable efforts to delete within 30 days" with a confirmation email on completion.
noah_finance: propose billing flow: they issue PO referencing order form id, we invoice on signature, net30 on invoice. if they want invoice before signature we can do pre-invoice with signed commitment email and finance approval — more manual but possible for enterprise.
sarah_sales: Acme procurement also asked about signature placement: they want countersign by their legal e-sig platform, and a separate PO number to be applied to the invoice. any objections?
eli_legal: countersign via their e-sign is fine as long as the MSA has our standard signature block and we get a copy of the fully executed doc. avoid attachments that change the MSA unless signed. if their e-sign tool forces changes, route to me.
contracts_bot: Reminder: Please attach the MSA PDF and check metadata fields for signer name + date. Missing PO numbers delay invoice processing.
mira_ps: For the dedicated test data path: we'll add the Data Handling Addendum + a short appendix that details the S3 ACLs and retention. i can draft wording and attach to thread in an hour.
sarah_sales: Great. next steps: @eli_legal to draft counterproposal to liability + deletion SLA; @mira_ps to attach appendix; @noah_finance to confirm invoice flow language. I'll reply back to customer by EOD with proposed changes and ask for their Billing contact for PO issuance. :pray:
eli_legal: will do. ill aim for a redline we can send via DocuSign or their e-sign. keep me looped if they push for HSM/KMS attestation — that's an enterprise ask and needs product input.
noah_finance: noted. if they provide billing contact tonight we can accept PO processing tomorrow morning.
jason_csm: I'll flag customer success to prep for onboarding once legal signs off.
sarah_sales: Thanks all — i'll post the customer's redline PDF here in a sec and tag for review. :white_check_mark:
